title: The Lake of Skeletons
subtitle: Roopkund, India
sources: Harney et al. (2019), Ancient DNA from the skeletons of Roopkund Lake reveals Mediterranean migrants in India, Nature Communications 10, 3670

beats: High in the Himalayas, there is a lake that keeps a secret.
Every summer, when the ice melts...
it gives back the dead.
Hundreds of them.

scenes.label: ROOPKUND
beats: Nineteen forty-two. Uttarakhand, in the Indian Himalayas.
A forest ranger named H. K. Madhwal climbs to a small glacial lake called Roopkund.
It sits about five thousand meters above sea level.

scenes.caption: ROOPKUND LAKE
beats: What he finds there is hard to believe.
Bones. Skulls. Scattered along the shore...
and frozen into the ice below.

scenes.head: Lost Soldiers of World War II
beats: At first, British officials feared these were Japanese soldiers, who had slipped into India during the war.
But the bones were far too old.

scenes.head: The King Who Angered a Goddess
beats: Local folk songs tell another story.
A king and his royal party, on a pilgrimage to the goddess Nanda Devi...
struck down by a storm of hail, as hard as iron.

scenes.head: A Deadly Hailstorm
beats: Strangely, science seemed to agree.
In two thousand four, researchers found skulls with deep, rounded wounds...
as if something hard had struck them from above.
Like giant hailstones.
Then, in twenty nineteen, a DNA study changed everything.
The people of Roopkund did not die together.
Most were South Asians, who died between the seventh and tenth centuries.
But one group died only around eighteen hundred...
about a thousand years later.

scenes.caption: DNA: EASTERN MEDITERRANEAN ANCESTRY
beats: And here is the strangest part.
Their DNA matched people from the eastern Mediterranean...
like Greece and Crete.
So how did they end up at a frozen lake in the Himalayas...
and what killed them there?
Nobody knows. Not yet.
What do you think happened at Roopkund? Tell us in the comments.
